newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Crash hampers Belgium-Netherlands rail traffic.
newsitem.headline: Crash hampers Belgium-Netherlands rail traffic.

text.p: A crash between a freight train and an engine nearon the Dutch-Belgian border caused disruption to rail traffic between the two countries which was expected to last through Thursday, Belgian railways said.

A NMBS/SNCB spokeswoman said the accident, which happened late on Wednesday, had made traffic north of the town of Roosendaal impossible, but trains from Belgium, coming from the south, could still reach Roosendaal station.
Passengers were being transported north to the Dutch towns of Breda and Rotterdam by bus, she said.
Details on the crash were not available.
